dedupe_keys.name: iris singapore rooftop infrared image dataset

description: Berkeley Education Alliance for Research in Singapore and collaborators publish IRIS, thermal imagery from two rooftop observatories at the National University of Singapore. Zenodo describes 1,365,921 infrared images from the Kent Vale and S16 sites, collected over about ten months with an average interval of ten seconds. The release supplies ten image archives and a weather-data archive, with companion Python examples for converting JPG observations to analysis tables. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The imagery can support neighbourhood-temperature and building-surface validation for simulations associated with model-energyplus. A caveat is that surface temperatures observed from rooftops do not directly equal indoor air temperature or heat flux. Camera position, occlusion and surface properties affect comparisons, and one campus does not represent all urban settings. No images were downloaded or temperatures reconstructed.
